q: Before performing Salat (prayer), a Muslim must perform ritual ablution called ____. (P2)
explain: Wudu purifies the believer physically and spiritually for prayer.

q: The opening chapter (Surah) of the Holy Qur'an recited in every prayer unit is Surah ____. (P2)
explain: Surah Al-Fatihah ('The Opening') comprises seven foundational verses.

q: Prophet Muhammad (SAW) was born in the holy city of ____. (P2)
explain: The Prophet (SAW) was born in Makkah in the Year of the Elephant (570 CE).

q: The mother of Prophet Muhammad (SAW) was Lady ____. (P2)
explain: Lady Aminah bint Wahb was the beloved mother of the Prophet (SAW).

q: Prophetic history (P2): Who was Prophet Adam (AS) in Islamic heritage?
options: the first human being and first prophet created by Allah
explain: Prophet Adam (AS) was the first human being and first prophet created by Allah.

q: Prophetic history (P2): Who was Prophet Ibrahim (AS) in Islamic heritage?
options: the Patriarch known as Khalilullah (Friend of Allah) who built the Ka'bah
explain: Prophet Ibrahim (AS) was the Patriarch known as Khalilullah (Friend of Allah) who built the Ka'bah.

q: Prophetic history (P2): Who was Prophet Musa (AS) in Islamic heritage?
options: the prophet who spoke with Allah (Kalimullah) and received the Tawrat
explain: Prophet Musa (AS) was the prophet who spoke with Allah (Kalimullah) and received the Tawrat.

q: Prophetic history (P2): Who was Prophet Isa (AS) in Islamic heritage?
options: the noble prophet born miraculously to Maryam who received the Injil
explain: Prophet Isa (AS) was the noble prophet born miraculously to Maryam who received the Injil.

q: Prophetic history (P2): Who was Prophet Nuh (AS) in Islamic heritage?
options: the prophet who built the Ark to save believers from the great deluge
explain: Prophet Nuh (AS) was the prophet who built the Ark to save believers from the great deluge.

q: Prophetic history (P2): Who was Prophet Dawud (AS) in Islamic heritage?
options: the prophet-king who received the holy Psalms (Zabur)
explain: Prophet Dawud (AS) was the prophet-king who received the holy Psalms (Zabur).
